comment: The release manifest's vectors (release.json: version, the cyfr, cyfr_locus, caddy and tailscale image digests and the scaffold tarball's digest). valid is a manifest every reader accepts and each refused manifest one every reader refuses: apps/codex/internal/release/manifest_test.go holds ParseManifest to both, and tests/ci-release-graph.py holds the release workflow's manifest check to them. signature is a test Sigstore instance's trusted root, the valid manifest's exact bytes with a v0.3 bundle signed under the release workflow's identity for signature.version, refused signed pairs each naming the step that refuses it (refused_by: signature, manifest or version), and a signed checksums.txt with the scaffold tarball it names, which the scaffold package's tests serve. manifest_test.go verifies them with VerifyManifest and VerifyBlob; `go test ./internal/release -run TestRegenerateFixture -regenerate` (from apps/codex) rewrites the signature section under a new instance and keeps the rest. Verification reads the signed timestamps, never the clock, so the section stays valid. A real bundle of the public-good instance is recorded beside these after the first tagged release that signs release.json.

refused.name: a tag in place of a digest
an image reference in place of a digest
a scaffold digest in upper case
signed by the release workflow at another tag
signed by the release workflow of another repository
signed by another workflow of the repository
signed by the release workflow on a branch
signed under the release identity by another issuer
another release's manifest, signed for its own tag
a manifest naming another version, signed for this tag
the caddy digest dropped after signing
a signed manifest without the caddy digest
a signed manifest without the tailscale digest
